ex.s: Performance： A dramatic presentation of the topic no more than 10 minutes long． If special clothes are used， they should truly represent a given period．
ex.t: 表演：对该主题进行的戏剧性展示，时长不超过10分钟。若使用了特殊服装，应真实代表某个特定时期。

ex.s: The researchers say that the keyboard should be pretty straightforward to commercialize and is mostly made of inexpensive, plastic-like parts.
ex.t: 研究人员表示，这种键盘商业化应该相当简单，它主要由廉价的塑料类部件组成。

ex.s: In fact, anyone wishing to try race walking should probably first consult a coach or experienced racer to learn proper technique, she says.
ex.t: 她说，事实上，任何想尝试竞走的人可能都应先咨询教练或有经验的竞走者，以学习正确技术。

ex.s: But if he's out there every day and playing hard, you should praise his effort regardless of whether his team wins or loses.
ex.t: 但如果他每天都在那里努力打球，无论他的球队输赢，你都应该赞扬他的努力。

ex.s: This issue won’t tell you what your ending should be — that’s up to you and the story you’re telling — but it might provide what you need to get there.
ex.t: 本期不会告诉你你的结局应该是什么——这取决于你和你要讲的故事——但它可能提供你所需要的帮助来实现它。

ex.s: He was thrilled to be doing the comedy that he always felt he should do, but even during his last few years, he always had a sense of curiosity, wondering what new role or challenge might be just around the corner.
ex.t: 他为自己能出演一直觉得应该演的喜剧而兴奋，但即使在生命的最后几年，他也始终保持着好奇心，想知道下一个新的角色或挑战可能就在眼前。

ex.s: The possibility of entering into and losing such a match should concentrate the minds of computer scientists.
ex.t: 陷入并输掉这样一局棋的可能性，理应让计算机科学家集中注意力。

defs.def: （与 I 或 we 连用代替 would，表示虚拟结果）就将

ex.s: If your student ID card no longer works or has been damaged, or if you have changed your personal or programme details, you should call into the Student Administration Centre （SAC） to request a new one.
ex.t: 如果你的学生证失效或损坏，或者你更改了个人或课程信息，你应到学生事务中心（SAC）申请补办。

ex.s: Research findings should be built on popular assumptions.
ex.t: 当我要离开时，朋友们送我到车旁。

defs.def: （在间接引语中用作 shall 的过去时）
（用于 that 引导的、表示建议或安排的从句中）

ex.s: It should be noted that none of the items on wastED’s menu was technically made from garbage.
ex.t: 值得注意的是，wastED菜单上的所有菜品严格来说都不是用垃圾制作的。

defs.def: （用于许多表示感情的形容词后的 that 从句中）
（与 I 和 we 连用，表示客气地请求）

ex.s: Established matrix gardens should not need the life support we give most gardens: fertilizer, dividing, regular watering.
ex.t: 成熟的矩阵花园不需要我们给大多数花园提供的那种生命支持：肥料、分株和定期浇水。

ex.s: All campers should bring their own bagged lunch and snacks.
ex.t: 所有营员应自带午餐和零食。

ex.s: ●Teachers and chaperones should model good behavior for the group and remain with students at all times.
ex.t: ●老师和陪同人员应为团体树立良好榜样，始终与学生在一起。

ex.s: ●Children should play nicely with each other and exhibits.
ex.t: ●儿童应友好地彼此相处和对待展品。

ex.s: You should remain modest when approaching perfection.
ex.t: 缺乏天赋和时间不是不采取行动的理由。

ex.s: Students should read the list with their parents / carers, and select two activities they would like to do.
ex.t: 学生应和家长/监护人一起阅读清单，并选择两项他们想做的活动。

ex.s: They should emphasize these skills when applying for jobs that require the ability to multitask.
ex.t: 申请人的简历列出任何涉及团队合作和目标导向责任的活动很重要。

ex.s: California, it should be noted, isn’t leading the way here.
ex.t: 即将到来的技术进步为城市和州提供了发展交通系统的机会，这些系统能够运送更多人，而且成本更低。

defs.def: （与 I 和 we 连用，表示没有把握）

ex.s: As it has been many years since I last used one, I should hardly be surprised that there are no longer any public telephones near my house.
ex.t: 距离我上次使用电话亭已经很多年了，所以我几乎不惊讶我家附近已经没有任何公用电话了。

ex.s: There is no reason you should exercise in the morning.
ex.t: 你没有理由非要在早上锻炼。

defs.def: （表示假如对方看见或经历某事物，一定会感兴趣或吃惊）真该，真应当

ex.s: Disruption should be given priority in social development.
ex.t: 我们大多数人都体验过做好事的美好感受，也体会过做正确之事有多难。

ex.s: They should look at making themselves as attractive as possible to employers.
ex.t: 作为在信息时代成长起来的一代，他们在展示自己在这方面的兴趣和技能时相当自信。
